items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1962-03-22
items.q: He used to call it Tate and Warner's band.

ctx.x: For me. For me. For me. He used to call it Tate and Warner's band.
Who was that violin player? Wasn't that violin player named Tate? No. Sales? I'm going to come over here and see you. What about Buddy Lock? Did you ever hear Buddy Lock?
